minimum_success_criteria: Every listed packet verifies PASS with tools/observer_verify_packet.py --public --json.
At least one missingness or parity scenario is represented without claiming intent or fraud.
The public summary distinguishes digest integrity from outcome correctness.
Synthetic placeholders are not described as live deployment evidence.
Every evaluator scenario maps to trust-recovery, human-review, and retention/disposition outputs.
Negative-control fixtures must reject tampered temporary packets with expected public problem codes.
Authenticated verifier demonstrations that use a trust keyset must pin the external trust-keyset bytes with --trust-keyset-sha256 or remain explicitly local/operator-trust only.

Authenticated verifier demonstrations that require current trust evidence must provide an external, byte-pinned trust-status snapshot with a valid freshness window and no revoked/omitted active signing keys.
Strict verification-policy lockfiles must path-scope trust inputs under a packet-external trust_input_base_dir and fail closed on unsafe routes.
current-authority source-review rows do not expire inside the near-term release cliff horizon
Safe-extractor negative controls remain executable and fast, while final release packaging still verifies and safely extracts the real ZIP artifact.

Current-date source pressure has zero expired and zero due-within-30-days rows; the 45-day current-authority queue is state/local-only and must not be used as current voter guidance without source-specific review.
Quarantined state/local xrefs require adopter-specific authority capture before public-guidance promotion; missing captures produce a no-go matrix.

Quarantined state/local example xrefs must remain official route examples only, with public-surface wording firewall checks, until adopter capture and validation promote an exact source for an exact jurisdiction/election/surface scope.
non_claims: This scenario does not prove an election outcome is correct.
This scenario does not replace statutory canvass, audit, certification, recount, or court procedure.
This scenario does not assert that missing evidence proves intent, fraud, or misconduct.
This scenario does not contain live deployment data.
Synthetic self-tests and evaluator PASS results are not independent third-party validation, certification, live-pilot authorization, or authorization to test live systems.
